text.hi: किताब कहती है: दिए गए शब्दों से पैराग्राफ़ लिखो। चलो कहानी को अपने वाक्यों में लिखते हैं।
text.hinglish: Kitaab kehti hai: diye gaye shabdon se paragraph likho. Chalo kahani ko apne vaakyon mein likhte hain.
text.en: The book says: write a paragraph with the given words. Let's write the story in our own sentences.

prompt.hi: शब्द: horse trainer, market, sell, horse
prompt.hinglish: Shabd: horse trainer, market, sell, horse
prompt.en: Words: horse trainer, market, sell, horse

steps.answer: The horse trainer went to the market to sell his horse.

meaning.hi: घोड़ा सिखाने वाला अपना घोड़ा बेचने बाज़ार गया।
meaning.hinglish: Ghoda sikhaane waala apna ghoda bechne baazaar gaya.

steps.answer: Bhola exchanged the donkey for a sheep.

meaning.hi: भोला ने गधे के बदले भेड़ ले ली।
meaning.hinglish: Bhola ne gadhe ke badle bhed le li.

steps.answer: Then he exchanged the sheep for a hen.

meaning.hi: फिर उसने भेड़ के बदले मुर्गी ले ली।
meaning.hinglish: Phir usne bhed ke badle murgi le li.

prompt.hi: शब्द: a girl, hen, green mangoes
prompt.hinglish: Shabd: a girl, hen, green mangoes
prompt.en: Words: a girl, hen, green mangoes

steps.answer: A girl gave him green mangoes for the hen.

meaning.hi: एक लड़की ने मुर्गी के बदले उसे हरे आम दिए।
meaning.hinglish: Ek ladki ne murgi ke badle use hare aam diye.

text.hi: अब आम पर पैराग्राफ़ (किताब का दूसरा सवाल)। ऐसे लिखो: The mango is the king of fruits. A mango tree gives us cool shade. Raw mangoes are green and sour. Ripe mangoes are yellow and sweet. We make jam, jelly, pickle and juice from mangoes. I love mangoes!
text.hinglish: Ab aam par paragraph (kitaab ka doosra sawaal). Aise likho: The mango is the king of fruits. A mango tree gives us cool shade. Raw mangoes are green and sour. Ripe mangoes are yellow and sweet. We make jam, jelly, pickle and juice from mangoes. I love mangoes!
text.en: Now the paragraph on mangoes (the book's second task). Write: The mango is the king of fruits. A mango tree gives us cool shade. Raw mangoes are green and sour. Ripe mangoes are yellow and sweet. We make jam, jelly, pickle and juice from mangoes. I love mangoes!

prompt.hi: आम के बारे में: कच्चे आम हरे और खट्टे होते हैं।
prompt.hinglish: Aam ke baare mein: kachche aam hare aur khatte hote hain.
prompt.en: About mangoes: say what raw mangoes are like.

steps.answer: Raw mangoes are green and sour.

meaning.hi: कच्चे आम हरे और खट्टे होते हैं।
meaning.hinglish: Kachche aam hare aur khatte hote hain.

prompt.hi: आम के बारे में: पके आम पीले और मीठे होते हैं।
prompt.hinglish: Aam ke baare mein: pake aam peele aur meethe hote hain.
prompt.en: About mangoes: say what ripe mangoes are like.

steps.answer: Ripe mangoes are yellow and sweet.

meaning.hi: पके आम पीले और मीठे होते हैं।
meaning.hinglish: Pake aam peele aur meethe hote hain.
